source_meta._title: When shooting an arrow on top of a player in Creative mode, a closed shulker, or an invincible mob, the arrow glitches around on top of the entity

stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition 19w14b in a single-player test world. Commands must be available, so create the world with Allow Cheats enabled or use another environment in which the executing player has command permission. Use a clear area with a solid, level floor and several blocks of unobstructed vertical space. Default keyboard and mouse controls are assumed; use the equivalent bound controls if they have been changed.
preconditions: Launch the first affected version, Minecraft 19w14b; do not use fix version 24w37a for the reproduction.
Commands are enabled for the executing player.
The player is in a loaded area with a solid, level floor and enough overhead clearance to fly above a shulker.
No seed, coordinates, world type, dedicated server, or additional player is required by the report.
The deterministic closed-shulker variant from the report is used rather than the alternative Creative-player, invulnerable-mob, or breeze variants.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, select and launch the Java Edition installation for 19w14b. Do not continue until the main menu identifies the selected version as 19w14b.
steps.success_cue: Minecraft Java Edition 19w14b is running and its main menu is responsive.

steps.action: Create or load a disposable single-player world in which commands are enabled. If creating a world, enable Allow Cheats before entering it. Wait until the surrounding terrain has rendered and movement responds normally.
steps.success_cue: The player is in a responsive, fully loaded world and can execute commands.

steps.action: Move to a clear, level section of solid ground with several blocks of empty space above it. Stand still on the block where the shulker should be summoned; the supplied relative coordinates summon it at the player's current position.
steps.success_cue: The player is stationary on a solid floor in an unobstructed test area.

steps.action: Open in-game chat using the chat control, whose default key is T.
steps.success_cue: The chat input field is open and ready to accept a command.

steps.action: Enter the report's summon command exactly as written, including the leading slash, spaces, capitalization, relative coordinates, braces, colon, and byte suffix. Press Enter once to execute it.
steps.success_cue: A shulker has appeared at the player's location without a command syntax error.

steps.action: Move a short distance away from the summoned shulker so it is clearly visible. Confirm that it is attached to the floor and that its shell is closed. Do not attack it or place blocks that would force it to relocate.
steps.success_cue: One stationary, closed shulker is visible on the floor in the clear test area.

steps.action: Open in-game chat again using the default chat key.
steps.success_cue: The chat input field is open.

steps.action: Set the executing player to Creative mode by entering the game-mode command, including the leading slash, and pressing Enter. This operationalizes the report's instruction to set the game mode to Creative.
steps.success_cue: The player is in Creative mode, with access to the Creative inventory and the ability to start flying by double-tapping Jump.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory using the inventory control, whose default key is E.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory interface and its item-category tabs are visible.

steps.action: Use the Creative inventory's Search Items tab, identified by the compass icon, and enter "bow" in its search field. Move one ordinary Bow from the search results into an empty hotbar slot. The hotbar is the row of nine item slots along the bottom of the inventory.
steps.success_cue: An ordinary Bow is present in one of the nine hotbar slots.

steps.action: Clear the search field, enter "arrow", and move at least one ordinary Arrow into the player's inventory or hotbar. Use a normal Arrow rather than a tipped or spectral arrow.
steps.success_cue: The player possesses an ordinary Bow and at least one ordinary Arrow.

steps.action: Close the inventory with E or Escape. Select the hotbar slot containing the Bow using its number key or the mouse wheel. The selected slot is the active slot and is shown with a highlighted border.
steps.exact_input: E, then the Bow's hotbar number or mouse wheel
steps.success_cue: The world view is visible and the player is holding the Bow in the active hotbar slot.

steps.action: Start Creative flight by pressing the Jump control twice in quick succession; the default Jump key is Space.
steps.success_cue: The player remains suspended when no block is beneath their feet, confirming that Creative flight is active.

steps.action: While flying, hold Jump to ascend several blocks above the shulker. Use the movement controls to position the player directly over the center of the closed shulker rather than beside it. Stop moving once aligned.
steps.exact_input: Hold Space; use W/A/S/D as needed
steps.success_cue: The player is hovering above the shulker with a clear, unobstructed line to the top of its closed shell.

steps.action: Rotate the camera until it points straight downward and center the crosshair on the middle of the shulker's top face. The shot must be approximately vertical: do not aim at the side or fire from an oblique angle, because the report comments distinguish straight-down shots from angled shots that bounce away.
steps.success_cue: The crosshair is centered on the top of the closed shulker while the player is hovering directly above it.

steps.action: Without changing position or aim, press and hold the Use Item control, whose default input is the right mouse button, until the Bow reaches its fully drawn visual state.
steps.success_cue: The Bow is visibly fully drawn while the crosshair remains centered on the shulker's top face.

steps.action: Release the right mouse button to fire one arrow straight downward into the top of the closed shulker. Keep the camera and player position steady while the arrow travels, and hand off as soon as the arrow makes its first contact with the top of the shulker.
steps.success_cue: The arrow has been fired on a straight-down trajectory and has just reached the top surface of the closed shulker.

stor.handoff_condition: One ordinary arrow has just made first contact with the top of the stationary, closed NoAI shulker after being fired approximately straight downward by a Creative-mode player. Begin observation immediately without firing additional arrows, moving the shulker, or changing the player's aim.
uncertainties: The report provides no seed, coordinates, world type, or server requirement; a disposable single-player world and any clear, level test area are practical implementation choices.

The report does not specify the player's initial game mode before summoning the shulker. The plan executes /gamemode creative after summoning to preserve the report's listed order without treating the initial mode as a requirement.

The exact flight height and use of a fully drawn bow are not specified. Several blocks of height and a full draw are chosen to make the straight-down impact easy to execute; the report-supported critical condition is that the arrow strike the top of the closed shulker approximately vertically.

The report lists Creative players, closed shulkers, invulnerable mobs, and a breeze as affected targets, but its formal reproduction uses the supplied NoAI shulker command. This plan therefore covers only that deterministic variant.
No external verification was used because the report supplies the exact summon command and all version-sensitive conditions necessary for its stated reproduction path.
